title: Regularised Iterative Generalised Least Squares with Optimal Selection of the Hyper-Parameter for Identifying Nonlinear Phenomenological Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.18742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In some fields currently dominated by empirical approaches, such as state of health (SoH) prediction for lithium-ion batteries, phenomenological models motivated by quasi-physical thinking contain parameters to be estimated from experimental data. Often the structure of such models yields fully or partially confounded parameters, which are difficult or even impossible to estimate reliably. To preserve the desired model formulation and simultaneously improve the numerical conditioning for the problem we introduce a ridge regression scheme. An automated method is provided, based on information theoretic measures of model performance, which optimises the ridge regression hyper-parameter at each iteration. The formulae presented require fixed point iteration to solve for the hyper-parameter. Given a suitable starting value, analysis demonstrates convergence is very rapid. translated_title: 正则化迭代广义最小二乘法及超参数最优选择用于识别非线性现象学模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：在某些目前由经验方法主导的领域，例如锂离子电池的健康状态（SoH）预测，受准物理思维启发的现象学模型包含需要从实验数据中估计的参数。这类模型的结构往往会导致参数完全或部分混杂，使得这些参数难以甚至无法可靠估计。为了保持所需的模型表述并同时改善问题的数值条件，我们引入了一种岭回归方案。提供了一种基于信息论模型性能度量的自动化方法，该方法在每次迭代中优化岭回归超参数。所提出的公式需要定点迭代来求解超参数。在合适的初始值下，分析表明收敛速度非常快。最优超参数选择机制被整合进该过程中。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合岭回归和自动超参数优化的迭代广义最小二乘方法，用于解决非线性现象学模型中参数混杂问题，并通过信息论准则和定点迭代实现快速收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a regularized iterative generalized least squares method with automatic hyper-parameter optimization via information-theoretic criteria and fixed-point iteration, addressing parameter confounding in nonlinear phenomenological models.
